subject: planner: correct plan when scan tidb related cluster table with KeepOrder (#51922)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` and `pkg/planner/core/task.go` (plus minimal surrounding code for property/TopN attach and TiDB-cop cluster table execution). Change correctly prevents cluster tables from being treated as order-preserving (avoids wrong ORDER BY plans) and adds a narrowly-scoped optimization for `CLUSTER_SLOW_QUERY` TopN to push a Limit into TiDB cop while keeping a global TopN in root for correctness. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and did not find follow-up fixes specific to this change.
